experiments.PZT: Atomiser only, 190 kHz/9 Vpp; no ZNMF jet; measured droplet-phase velocities; ambient gas unmeasured
experiments.ZNMF: Air jet only without PZT droplets; mean two-component gas velocities

pzt.coordinates: Saved x_mm,y_mm retained in image-reference frame, x right/y up
pzt.velocities: Saved mean_u,mean_v and frame u,v read directly in m/s
pzt.scaling: No velocity recalibration; coordinates converted mm to m only for integration
pzt.population: Finite-pair population without flag-code rejection; upstream replacement and flag meanings are not assigned.

znmf.coordinates: Local Xj=x*D0; Yj=(y-6.868)*D0, from registered dimensionless arrays; no use of y_plot
znmf.velocity: U,V already m/s; downstream sign reversal already applied upstream, not applied again
znmf.masks: Both stored U,V finite; preserve upstream reconstruction support; bilinear evaluation only in cells with four finite paired vectors
znmf.reconstruction: Authoritative three-FOV reconstructed mean, including its existing overlap registration/blending; not reprocessed

placement.common_frame: Prediction x horizontal/rightward and y upward; ZNMF downstream points upward after +90 degree analysis-copy rotation
placement.pzt_transform: Identity: common frame retains final PZT right/up axes and image-reference origin
placement.warning: Origins of the two experiments are not equated

co_directed_alignment.formula_positions: x=x_PZT_ref + Yj_c_at_interaction - Yj; y=y_PZT_interaction + Xj - s_ZNMF_interaction
co_directed_alignment.interpretation: Independent source profile coordinates paired as in archived comparison; measured centrelines aligned only at interaction plane, not physical exits; wandering and transverse offsets retained

saved_properties.air_density_note: NIST dry-air reference 1.20479 kg/m3; approximate 20 C, pressure scaled; not measured density
saved_properties.mu_air_note: Sutherland: mu0=1.716e-5 Pa s, T0=273.15 K, S=110.4 K

assumptions: Nominal axes co-directed upward; signed local gas velocities retained, not forced positive
